title: Define generation economics

settlementAsset.rule: 420Hz may display canonical amounts but may not mint, custody, reserve, release, claim, refund or redirect settlement value itself

economicStates.meaning: non-binding cost/capacity preview derived from current qualified source data; creates no reservation or payment right
versioned/expiring quote snapshot for the exact GenerationIntent; remains non-canonical until accepted through 420AI/ComputeMarket
explicit payer maximum spend authorization for the exact request/funding scope
actual payer-backed job credit/funding reference exists within the authorized maximum
immutable accepted provider/resource/price/beneficiary snapshot bounded by payer max, actual funded credit and scoped accept-match authorization
objectively verified provider earning/entitlement for exact accepted work; not yet proof of external payout
verified/final provider entitlement has become claimable to the frozen canonical beneficiary
actual provider payout/claim movement completed to the frozen beneficiary
unearned payer-backed residual has been classified as refundable; no external refund implied
refund amount is claimable/withdrawable by the bound payer
only the specifically contested not-yet-released entitlement/refund is held pending canonical resolution

quoteRules: Every quote binds the exact GenerationIntent/request commitment, model/version or capability class, workload controls that materially affect price, privacy/verification profile, pricing-policy/version reference, quoted amount, maximum amount shown to the user, settlement asset, expiry and quote source timestamp/reference.
QUOTED is application state only and does not prove provider capacity reservation, funding, acceptance, entitlement or payout.
A material request change, quote expiry, provider/resource revision drift or incompatible capacity/privacy/verification change invalidates the quote and requires re-quote before submission.
420Hz must label estimated ranges separately from exact accepted price and must not present an estimate as guaranteed final cost.

Current qualified fixed-price ComputeMarket admission may be displayed as an exact candidate quote only while its offer/revision remains valid; future pricing models require an explicit versioned policy rather than reinterpretation.
authorizationAndFundingRules: The payer maximum is explicit, bounded and specific to the exact request/funding scope; 420Hz may not use an unbounded legacy max-spend path for paid generation.
Payer and requester may differ only when the payer has independently authorized the funding obligation.
Actual funded credit must be payer/job-bound and cannot be inferred from Vault-wide free balance, donor surplus, a payment receipt alone or an application ledger.
Funding amount cannot exceed the payer-authorized maximum.
420Hz must distinguish payment authorization from actual canonical funding confirmation.
420Pay, if used for user-facing payment acquisition, does not replace ComputeMarket/Vault job funding and settlement authority.
acceptedPriceRules: Accepted price must be <= payer signed/authorized maximum.
Accepted price must be <= actual job-specific Vault-backed funded credit.
Accepted price must be <= the amount limit of the scoped accept-match capability.
Accepted price freezes the exact provider/resource revision, provider-derived beneficiary, pricing policy/version, accepted amount and payer/funding references.
Matching/acceptance creates no provider earning or payout by itself.
No scheduler, UI, provider endpoint change or later provider revision may redirect the frozen beneficiary or raise the accepted price.
entitlementAndSettlementRules: Provider earning requires canonical verification under the preaccepted verification policy; worker/provider signature alone is insufficient.
For every payable unit/result, retries and resubmissions share one canonical entitlement key; duplicate attempts cannot create second payment.
sum(verified earnings plus explicitly accepted fees) <= accepted aggregate price <= payer maximum <= payer-backed funded reserve.
PROVIDER_CLAIMABLE and PROVIDER_PAID are distinct states; VERIFIED_EARNED alone is not proof of Vault transfer.
Provider payout recipient is the already-bound canonical beneficiary and may never be supplied or replaced by a 420Hz client at settlement time.

Partial provider earning is allowed only when the accepted job/verification policy explicitly supports partial units/results; subjective dissatisfaction is not a unilateral reason to rewrite verified entitlement.
No 420Hz administrator, governance role, application server or UI may confiscate, redirect or fabricate provider entitlement.
cancellationFailureRefundRules: DRAFT/QUOTED cancellation before canonical funding/acceptance creates no provider charge and requires no fabricated refund state.
After funding, cancellation/expiry/failure/refund semantics are determined by the canonical AI/Compute/Vault lifecycle; a local cancel click cannot promise or execute a refund.
Unused/unearned payer-backed value remains payer-bound and may become refundable/claimable only through canonical accounting.
PAYER_REFUNDABLE, PAYER_REFUND_CLAIMABLE and PAYER_REFUND_PAID must be displayed distinctly.
Vault cancelObligation or a freed internal balance alone is not an external payer refund.
A settled under-budget job returns/resolves unused payer-backed value under the canonical refund path without reopening settled provider earnings.
Failed/expired/disputed jobs cannot be shown as refunded until the corresponding canonical refund state/reference proves the applicable stage.
Refunds return only to the recorded/bound payer or authorized payer route; 420Hz cannot nominate an alternate refund recipient.
retryReplayRules: A transient retry/resubmission of the same canonical unit/job cannot create a second payable entitlement.
A duplicate client request/idempotency key must resolve to the same economic intent/job or fail closed.

A genuinely new paid attempt after a terminal FAILED/CANCELLED result requires a new GenerationIntent/run, fresh quote where required and fresh explicit payer authorization unless the canonical recovery policy reuses the already-funded entitlement.
420Hz may never silently recharge a user because a provider/network timeout occurred.
Lost-response recovery must reconcile canonical funding/acceptance/receipt/settlement before deciding whether any new economic action is allowed.
disputeRules: A dispute may hold only the specific contested not-yet-released entitlement/refund under the accepted challenge policy.
Unaffected verified units/entitlements may proceed when canonical policy permits.
An allegation, popularity score, subjective quality complaint or provider reputation alone cannot create a refund, payout denial or slash.
Final dispute resolution cannot mint a second entitlement, change the frozen provider beneficiary or consume another payer's credit.
Open appeal/finality gates must be respected before claimable payout where the accepted policy requires them.
sponsorshipAndSubsidyRules: Optional sponsorship, grant, research-pool or ecosystem funding may reduce the user's own funded portion only when a canonical funding source/pool explicitly authorizes and backs the exact job/request.
420Hz may display a subsidy/sponsor contribution only from canonical observable funding records and must identify the payer/funding source separately from the requester.

A sponsor match, useful-computation reward, research reward or contribution reward is a distinct economic surface and must not be relabeled as a generation-provider payment, user refund or discount unless the canonical funding path explicitly funds that job.
No community/award popularity metric creates a compute subsidy or provider entitlement.
If sponsored funding disappears, expires or is insufficient before acceptance, the job must re-quote/re-authorize or fail closed; 420Hz may not silently shift the amount to the user.

feePolicy.futureRule: any future 420Hz application/service fee requires an explicit versioned policy, separate line item, clear beneficiary and separate user authorization; it must fit within the displayed total maximum and cannot be hidden inside provider cost
feePolicy.providerFees: only fees explicitly part of the canonical accepted pricing policy may be charged
feePolicy.taxesOrExternalFees: not invented by this architecture step; if later applicable they must be explicit and separately authorized

uiPresentationRules: Before submission show settlement asset, quote/estimate status, quoted amount or range, payer maximum, quote expiry and whether funding/subsidy is expected.
After canonical acceptance show exact accepted price separately from the earlier estimate/quote.
Display provider earning, provider claimable and provider paid as different states.
Display payer refundable, refund claimable and refund paid as different states.
Do not show 'refunded' based only on AI status, app bookkeeping, cancelObligation, a support decision or pending withdrawal.
Do not show 'paid provider' based only on VERIFIED, SETTLED facade state or application receipt unless canonical Vault/settlement evidence establishes the intended meaning.
Cost/capacity preview must disclose stale/unavailable pricing rather than inventing a default amount.

rules: Every amount is counted exactly once in the applicable stage.
No amount may exceed payer-backed funding.
A dispute hold reclassifies an existing bounded liability; it does not create new value.
Application estimates/quotes are excluded from reconciliation until canonical funding/acceptance occurs.

failureRules: quote above payer maximum fails closed
accepted price above actual job funding fails closed
accepted price above scoped capability amount fails closed
stale/expired quote used for paid submission fails closed
payer/requester mismatch without independent payer authorization fails closed
duplicate payable entitlement for retry/replay fails closed
provider payout before required verification/finality fails closed
refund to any recipient other than the bound payer/authorized payer route fails closed
application label claiming PAID or REFUNDED without canonical evidence is invalid
sponsor/subsidy claim without canonical funded source fails closed
silent transfer of expired/insufficient sponsor amount to the user fails closed
economic state disagreement between app cache and canonical source fails closed for new spending/settlement actions
invariants: HZGCA-ECON-001 QUOTED is non-canonical application state and creates no capacity, custody, entitlement or payout authority
HZGCA-ECON-002 payer maximum authorization is explicit and bounded for the exact request; unbounded legacy max-spend is not accepted for paid Generate
HZGCA-ECON-003 accepted price never exceeds payer maximum, actual job-specific funded credit or scoped accept-match amount
HZGCA-ECON-004 accepted provider/resource/beneficiary/pricing terms are immutable for the accepted job
HZGCA-ECON-005 matching and acceptance create no provider earnings or payout
HZGCA-ECON-006 RESULT_COMMITTED is not verified earning and provider signature alone cannot unlock settlement
HZGCA-ECON-007 one canonical payable entitlement exists per accepted unit/result across retries and replays
HZGCA-ECON-008 verified earning, provider claimable and provider paid are distinct economic states
HZGCA-ECON-009 payer refundable, refund claimable and refund paid are distinct economic states
HZGCA-ECON-010 cancelObligation/free-balance bookkeeping is never presented as actual payer refund
HZGCA-ECON-011 unused/unearned payer-backed value remains payer-bound and cannot subsidize another payer/job
HZGCA-ECON-012 refund recipient and provider beneficiary are canonical bound identities, never caller-selected by 420Hz
HZGCA-ECON-013 retry/network recovery cannot silently recharge the user or create duplicate provider entitlement
HZGCA-ECON-014 dispute holds are bounded to contested liabilities and cannot confiscate unrelated payer/provider value
HZGCA-ECON-015 canonical sponsorship/subsidy is distinct from provider reward/refund and cannot be fabricated from community/award signals
HZGCA-ECON-016 no hidden 420Hz surcharge exists; any future application fee requires explicit versioned separate authorization
HZGCA-ECON-017 application economic presentation must fail closed on stale/conflicting canonical state rather than inventing price/payment/refund status
HZGCA-ECON-018 HZ-GCA-1.9 creates no custody, Vault, settlement, minting, payment, subsidy, rights or governance authority for 420Hz
exitCriteria: provider earning/claimable/paid and payer refundable/claimable/paid states are distinct
accepted-price bounds and beneficiary immutability are explicit
optional canonical sponsorship/subsidy is separated from provider rewards and user refunds
hidden 420Hz surcharge is prohibited and future fee policy requires separate authorization
UI truthfulness and exact economic reconciliation rules are explicit
machine verifier enforces economic vocabulary, bounds, separation and no-authority invariants
no live quote, deployed funding adapter, provider price, production fee or testnet state is invented
HZ-GCA-1 remains open for HZ-GCA-1.10 through HZ-GCA-1.20
